title: 第2356章 繁衍桎梏风起王尧第2355章 阵通万域定策安民
content_zh:
接下来数日，莫凡搁置修行课业，日日伴在云柔、白夭夭身侧，朝夕相守、温存相伴。
此前亲眼见证喳喳、红眼等一众旧部小妖，已然繁衍出数十上百代子孙，族群兴盛、香火绵延，莫凡心中也悄然生出几分期许，渴望能与两女孕育子嗣、圆满羁绊。
可他渐渐发现，修士求子，难于登天。
凡俗之人顺应天地阴阳生机，循自然之道孕育子嗣，血脉绵延、代代相传，乃是天道常态。
但修行之路本就是逆天夺造化、逆流争长生。
修士每一次破境蜕变，皆是剥离凡俗血肉、洗练肉身神魂，不断挣脱轮回桎梏、超脱凡俗天道。
境界越高，肉身灵力越精纯、生命本质越趋近天地道体，与凡俗繁衍之道愈发背离。
体内磅礴精纯的元力，非但无法滋养灵胎，反而会轻易冲碎初生生机，这是高阶修士与生俱来的修行桎梏。
几番温存体悟、潜心摸索，莫凡终于洞悉了最核心的症结。
此方天地自有平衡铁律。
天道许修士逆天修行、超脱轮回、寿元无尽，便会以“断绝血脉延续”为代价，制衡诸天强者，不让绝世天骄无限繁衍、垄断天地气运，避免万族争锋沦为一族独大。
这是诸天天道的隐性桎梏，是无可撼动的天地平衡规则。
夜色渐深，清辉明月悬于夜幕，洒落一地清冷柔光。
云柔静静倚在莫凡身侧，眉眼间褪去了往日的温婉自信，萦绕着几分低落怅然，轻声开口，嗓音带着一丝不易察觉的酸涩：“夫君，难道……我们终究无法拥有属于自己的子嗣吗？”
莫凡闻言心头一软，伸手温柔揉了揉她的发丝，将她轻轻拥入怀中，温声安抚：“傻丫头，怎会如此。”
“属于我们的孩子，一定会有的。
此事受制于天道桎梏，急不来，我们慢慢来便是。”
他抬眸望向窗外高悬的明月，眼底温柔尽数收敛，取而代之的是一往无前的桀骜与锋芒，沉声低语，字字铿锵：“柔儿你记住，我辈修士，本就是逆天而行、抗争天道。”
“即便天道设限、大道不允，朕！也要亲手捅开这漫天桎梏！”
……

诸事落定，域门安稳，莫凡本以为终于能卸下连日紧绷的心弦，安稳休憩、伴伴佳人。
可这份难得的闲适尚未持续多久，一道急促的传音便骤然划破静谧，打断了他的悠然时光。
“帝君，宫外有陌生修士求见。”
是红眼的声音，语气格外郑重，全无往日的跳脱散漫。
“此人并非我黑风山在册修士，却态度执拗，执意要当面觐见帝君，言说有机密大事，非亲口禀报不可。”
莫凡闻言微怔，心头生出几分疑惑。
他素来知晓，红眼看似粗疏跳脱、不拘小节，实则值守公务极为谨慎细致，轻重分寸拿捏得恰到好处，若非事态蹊跷特殊，绝不会这般郑重传讯打扰。
心念至此，莫凡即刻传音回问：“可知其姓名、来历与修为境界？”“回帝君，此人自称王尧，居于黑风山脚下俗世小镇，言称突发紧急要事，特意赶来觐见。
修为低微，仅仅只是圣境初期的人族修士。”红眼如实回禀。
“王尧……”
莫凡低声呢喃，眼底满是茫然，脑海中搜寻良久，全无半点相关印象，心中愈发疑惑：朕从未识得此人。
传音另一端的红眼听出他的陌生，当即请示道：“帝君，此人身份不明、贸然求见，要不要属下将其拿下，直接搜魂核验真伪？”
content_en:
In the next few days, Mo Fan put aside his training and studies and stayed by Yunrou and Bai Yaoyao's side day and night, lovingly accompanying them day and night.
Having witnessed with his own eyes that Chatcha, Hongyan and other old demons have spawned dozens or hundreds of generations of descendants, the clan is prosperous and the incense continues, Mo Fan also quietly has some expectations in his heart, longing to have children and complete the bond with the two girls.
But he gradually discovered that it was difficult for a monk to reach heaven if he wanted to have a son.
Ordinary people conform to the yin and yang vitality of heaven and earth, and give birth to children according to the natural way. The blood line is extended and passed down from generation to generation, which is the normal state of heaven.
But the path of spiritual practice is to fight against nature and seize fortune, and to fight against the current to fight for immortality.
Every time a monk breaks through the realm and transforms, he strips off his mortal flesh and blood, refines his physical body and soul, constantly breaks away from the shackles of reincarnation, and transcends the mortal world and the way of heaven.
The higher the realm, the purer the physical body and spiritual power, the closer the essence of life is to the Tao of heaven and earth, and the more it deviates from the ordinary way of reproduction.
The majestic and pure Yuan Power in the body, instead of being able to nourish the spiritual fetus, can easily crush the newborn vitality. This is the inherent shackles of practice for high-level monks.
After several gentle realizations and painstaking explorations, Mo Fan finally understood the core crux.
The world here has its own iron law of balance.
The way of heaven allows monks to practice against the will of heaven, transcend reincarnation, and live forever, at the cost of "cutting off the continuation of the bloodline" to check and balance the powerful ones in the world, prevent the unparalleled genius from multiplying infinitely, monopolize the destiny of the world, and prevent the competition among all races from becoming one family's dominance.
This is the hidden shackles of the heavens and the unshakable rules of balance between heaven and earth.
The night is getting darker, and the bright moon hangs in the night, casting cool and soft light all over the place.
Yunrou leaned quietly beside Mo Fan, her brows and eyes lost the gentleness and confidence of the past, and there was a bit of dejection lingering. She spoke softly, with a hint of sourness in her voice that was not easy to detect: "Husband, can it be that... we can't have an heir of our own after all?"
Mo Fan's heart softened when he heard this, he reached out and gently rubbed her hair, gently hugged her into his arms, and comforted her with a gentle voice: "Silly girl, how could this happen?"
“There will definitely be children who belong to us.
This matter is subject to the shackles of heaven. There is no rush, we just take our time. "
He raised his eyes to look at the bright moon hanging high outside the window. All the gentleness in his eyes had faded away, replaced by unyielding and sharp edge. He whispered in a deep voice, with sonorous words: "Rou'er, remember, monks like us are meant to go against heaven and fight against heaven."
"Even if the law of heaven sets limits and the great road does not allow it, I! I will still break through the shackles of the sky with my own hands!"
…
Everything was settled and the domain was stable. Mo Fan thought he could finally let go of his tense heartstrings and rest peacefully with his beautiful wife.
But this rare leisurely moment had not lasted long when a rapid voice transmission suddenly broke through the silence, interrupting his leisurely time.
"Emperor, there are strange monks outside the palace who want to see you."
It was a red-eyed voice, and the tone was extremely solemn, without any of the casualness of the past.
"This person is not a registered monk of Black Wind Mountain, but he is stubborn and insists on meeting the emperor face to face. He said that there are important secrets that must be reported in person."
Mo Fan was slightly startled when he heard the words, and he had some doubts in his heart.
He has always known that Hongyan may seem careless and informal, but in fact he is extremely cautious and meticulous in his official duties, and he has the right balance of importance. If the situation was not strange and special, he would never be disturbed by such a solemn summons.
With this in his mind, Mo Fan immediately sent a message to ask: "Do you know his name, origin, and level of cultivation?" "Back to the emperor, this man calls himself Wang Yao, and lives in a small town at the foot of Black Wind Mountain. He said that something urgent happened and came here to see him.
His cultivation level is low, he is just a human monk in the early stage of the Holy Realm. "Red Eyes replied truthfully.
"Wang Yao..."
Mo Fan murmured in a low voice, his eyes full of confusion. He searched for a long time in his mind, but there was no relevant impression at all. He became more and more confused: I have never known this person.
The red eyes on the other end of the transmission heard his strangeness and immediately asked for instructions: "Emperor, this person's identity is unknown and he rashlyI beg you to see me, do you want my subordinates to take it down and search its soul directly to verify its authenticity? "
